summary:
洛克希德馬丁本季 EPS 低於預期4.3%，營收幾近持平，計畫成本壓力浮現。
• EPS 6.44 美元，低於預估6.73（-4.34%）。
• 營收18.02億美元（B級），年增僅0.32%。
• 國防訂單背書（backlog）仍提供長期能見度。
• 本益比25.90，估值處中性區間。
ai_view:
訊號偏弱：EPS 不及預期且營收近乎零成長，反映計畫成本超支與認列時程拖累。短期股價缺乏向上催化，需留意利潤率指引。中期支撐仍來自龐大訂單背書與地緣國防需求結構性上升。追蹤指標：訂單背書金額與訂單出貨比（book-to-bill）、固定價格合約損失提列、自由現金流與股東回報。25.9倍本益比對防禦型國防股略偏高，需業績回穩支撐。

需留意：固定價格合約成本超支侵蝕利潤率。；國防預算編列與撥款時程不確定。；F-35 等大型計畫的交付與認列節奏波動。

summary_en:
Lockheed Martin missed EPS by 4.3% with flat revenue, as program cost pressures surfaced.
• EPS of $6.44 missed the $6.73 estimate by 4.34%.
• Revenue of $18.02B grew just 0.32% year over year.
• Defense backlog still provides long-term visibility.
• P/E of 25.90 sits in a neutral range.

ai_view_en:
Signal is soft: an EPS miss with near-zero revenue growth reflects program cost overruns and recognition timing. Near-term the stock lacks upside catalysts and margin guidance bears watching. Mid-term support comes from a large backlog and structurally rising geopolitical defense demand. Track backlog and book-to-bill, fixed-price loss charges, free cash flow, and shareholder returns. A 25.9x P/E is a touch rich for a defensive defense name and needs earnings to stabilize.

Watch：Cost overruns on fixed-price contracts erode margins.; Defense budget timing and appropriations are uncertain.; Delivery and recognition timing on major programs like F-35 are volatile.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 較預估低4.34%，營收年增僅0.32%近乎停滯。
